dataset_title: Uttara University Admission Eligibility and Tuition Fee Knowledge Base
language: English data fields with Bangla chatbot usage intended
important_usage_notice: This dataset is transcribed from Uttara University's official public website pages checked on 2026-11-22.
The published tuition fee table is for Spring 2027 and was last updated 2026-11-19. Fees may change in later intakes.
The chatbot must not invent missing eligibility or fee information.
A published scholarship-adjusted maximum cost is not a guaranteed personal payable amount. Student eligibility and scholarship approval must be confirmed by the university.
For rows marked manual confirmation required, the chatbot must not give a definitive eligibility answer.
This dataset is a local static knowledge base. It can answer without calling Gemini or another API only if the application implements direct JSON lookup and templated responses.

university_contact.note: The tuition page shows admission@uttara.ac.bd and 09640888000; department pages show hotline 01872607360-69. Use the official contact page to confirm which number to display.

chatbot_instructions.answer_without_ai_api: For exact program-name queries, search this JSON locally and construct the answer from matching records. Do not call Gemini for simple fee/eligibility lookup.
chatbot_instructions.language: Reply in the user's language (Bangla or English).
chatbot_instructions.fee_answer_format: Show published total cost, admission fee, first-admission payable amount, published scholarship offer and published scholarship-adjusted maximum cost. Label all amounts as Spring 2027 published figures.
chatbot_instructions.eligibility_answer_format: Show general student, diploma, English-medium or postgraduate conditions separately as applicable. If missing or ambiguous, say it needs confirmation from Admission Office.
chatbot_instructions.fallback: দুঃখিত, এই বিষয়ে আমার কাছে যাচাইকৃত নির্দিষ্ট তথ্য নেই। অনুগ্রহ করে Uttara University Admission Office-এ যোগাযোগ করুন: 09640 888272 অথবা admission@uttara.ac.bd।
never_do: Never treat scholarship-adjusted cost as guaranteed final bill.
Never combine unrelated scholarships or calculate a student's award unless the official policy clearly allows it.
Never infer a diploma subject requirement from another program.
Never fabricate documents, deadlines, admission test dates, or fees.
Never tell a student they are officially eligible or admitted; only provide preliminary guidance.
chatbot_instructions.monthly_fee_answer_rule: When asked for monthly cost, use fees.monthly_average_cost_bdt and fees.monthly_average_after_published_scholarship_bdt. Explain that these are average budgeting estimates calculated from published total cost and program duration, not guaranteed monthly instalments. Also provide the published total cost and advise confirmation of actual payment schedule with the Finance and Accounts Office.

data_quality_notes: The Civil Engineering diploma-holder text on the official entry requirements page appears to contain a copy/paste inconsistency referring to FDT Evening and textile-related technology. This record is flagged for manual confirmation.
The official fee page has fee records for BPEd, MPEd, BEd and MEd, but the captured entry requirements page does not provide complete BEd/MEd admission criteria.
Some graduate programs listed on the graduate-programs page do not have separate fee rows on the current fee page; do not invent their fee.
The fee table includes regular published program totals and a scholarship-adjusted maximum-cost column. The latter should be described exactly as published, not as a guaranteed student's net fee.

monthly_cost_calculation.purpose: Show an estimated monthly budget for every listed program, not only the full-program total.
monthly_cost_calculation.formula: Published total program cost ÷ estimated program duration in months.
monthly_cost_calculation.general_program_calendar: 4 months per semester, based on the published 2027 academic calendar for programs other than Law.
monthly_cost_calculation.law_program_calendar: 6 months per bi-semester, based on the published 2027 academic calendar for the Department of Law.
monthly_cost_calculation.important_caveat: Monthly average is a budgeting estimate, not a statement that the university invoices exactly this amount every month. The university's Finance and Accounts Office controls actual payment deadlines and instalments.
